title: Kubernetes Fundamentals
description: How a Kubernetes cluster actually works: pods, controllers, networking, storage, and the day-to-day commands that keep it running.

changelog.notes: Converted 23 practice cards that tested plain concept recall (e.g. "control plane", "a chart", "a demo") from typing types to tap-based select_blank -- typing cards should be reserved for actual kubectl/CLI syntax.
Glossary: every term now points at one link, so the same word never sends you to two different pages.
Adds Learn more articles (16, each with a worked example) for the glossary terms; tapping a term now offers "Read the full explanation".
Removes the Wikipedia links from glossary terms that have a Learn more article; the article is now the single place to read more.
Rewrites the Learn more articles in a warmer, teacher-to-student voice; no change to the content or the glossary.
Cards: a few explanations and answer options no longer use terms taught later; rolling updates and rollbacks are now introduced with Deployments.
